h:
这就是我目前作为标准工作流程运行的内容。

可以使用组旁路器绕过任何或所有组。而且它应该仍然可以正常工作。

团体：

Outpaint，这是一个简单的 outpaint 组，可以根据提示在其上快速运行，添加到画布并进行细化。然后将其发送到高噪声的主采样器。目的是锁定总体姿势和布局。例如，您最初迅速切割头顶。将其输入到外画中，在顶部添加像素。主采样器现在应该看到头部上方应该有空间，瞧，它可以工作了。

详细信息：

确实是标准细节，除了它具有动态高档的修复区域。

种子VR2：

确实升级了，仅此而已。

调整：

用于级别、锐化和饱和度调整的组。

如果您缺少任何节点，comfyui 管理器应该能够帮助您找到它们。除了主权分辨率选择器之外，它是一个未发布的本地分辨率选择器。它是未连接的，可以轻松地与您自己喜欢的进行交换。

如果有任何问题，请随时提问，祝你好运。

o.en:
This is what I currently run as my standard workflow.

Any or all groups can be bypassed using the group bypasser. And it should still work correctly.

Groups:

Outpaint, It is a simple outpaint group that takes the prompt does a quick run on it, adds to the canvas and refines. Then sends it to the main sampler with a high denoise. With the purpose of locking in the general pose and layout. Example, your initial prompt cuts of the top of the head. Feed it to the outpaint, add pixels att the top. The main sampler should now see there should be room above the head and voila, it works.

Detailer:

Standard detailer really, with the exception of it having a dynamic upscale of the inpaint area.

SeedVR2:

Upscaling really, not much more to it.

Adjust:

A group for levels, sharpening and saturation adjustments.

Should you lack any nodes the comfyui manager should be able to help you find them. With the excpetion of the Sovereign res selector that is an unpublished local resolution selector. It is unconnected and can be easily swapped with your own favorite.

Feel free to ask questions should there be any, and Good luck.
